common.noscript: The calculators need JavaScript to work.

eggs.title: Egg calculator
eggs.description: How many eggs have you eaten? Count them, weigh them and find out how many hens you keep busy.
eggs.heading: How many eggs did you eat?

work.title: Working days calculator
work.description: Count working days and hours between two dates, minus public holidays and days off — plus your pay and the eggs you ate on the job.
work.heading: How many days did you work?

timer.title: Boiled egg timer
timer.description: Perfect soft, medium or hard boiled eggs every time: a timer that accounts for egg size, starting temperature and altitude.
timer.heading: Boiled egg timer
timer.hint: Lower the egg into boiling water, then start the timer.
timer.source: Times use Charles D. H. Williams' formula from “The Physics of Cooking an Egg”.

age.title: Age calculator
age.description: How old are you in days, hours and heartbeats — and when is your next big round day?
age.heading: How old are you, really?

countdown.title: Countdown
countdown.description: How many days, weeks and working days are left until your vacation, deadline or big day?
countdown.heading: How long until…

pizza.title: Pizza calculator
pizza.description: Is one big pizza better value than two small ones? Compare pizzas by price per area.
pizza.heading: Which pizza is the best deal?

split.title: Bill splitter
split.description: Split the bill and the tip between friends in seconds.
split.heading: Split the bill
split.roundUp: Round each share up to a whole amount

about.title: About
about.heading: About
about.intro: Hey! Thanks for visiting the egg calculator website. It started as a practice website for learning to code and counting eggs. At some point, it turned into a small collection of everyday calculators. What can't you find on the web, am I right?
about.privacy: No cookies, no tracking, no accounts. Everything is calculated in your browser, and your last inputs are only remembered on your own device. Public holidays come from the free Nager.Date API through this server, so your address is never shared with anyone else.
